messages.content: What are the symptoms of hypertension?
Hypertension may not cause noticeable symptoms. When symptoms occur, they can include headache, dizziness, or visual disturbances.
Type 2 diabetes is a chronic condition in which the body does not use insulin effectively, resulting in elevated blood glucose levels.
Anemia is a condition in which the blood does not have enough healthy red blood cells or hemoglobin to carry adequate oxygen to the body's tissues.
